verdict.rationale: Marqeta is a card-issuing/payments API platform; no evidence exists of a data export feature in open formats or account portability for users leaving the platform. Data available is transactional (cards, transactions, disputes) accessed via API, but there is no documented bulk-export tool or open-format data portability mechanism, and probes for llms.txt/openapi endpoints returned 404s, suggesting limited self-service data export tooling. missing for 10: any documented export/download feature, open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk export capability, or account-closure data portability guarantee.
